original: They are all fighting for what they believe in。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
No。 You must fight for what you believe in。
Alouette、 your brother Culotte、 Eclair and Father Salade。。。

Then at least they will have done their best。 That is fate。
